scope: Local virtual-host CLI measurements; no physical qualification or P15 certificate.
numerical_scope: Exact no-dither signed-32 PCM output identity for every captured conversion.
intervals: Per-case paired bootstrap intervals, not simultaneous family-wise confidence bounds.

hardware.governor_and_boost: not changed by this tool; record externally
hardware.io: Generated input files; raw signed-32 little-endian PCM output; all output bytes hashed after each timed child exits.

config.equality_scope: exact no-dither int32 CLI output bytes in this corpus; not a binary64 arithmetic proof
config.rss: per-child wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB on Linux, including process launch footprint
config.timings: steady input processing plus CLI startup, input/output I/O; short cases expose startup
